from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection, with its title and list of cited references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper, as written")
    citations: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other works referenced in this paper's bibliography, as extracted")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all papers found in the input collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
